where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
expected_result: All money visible. Foreman has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Foreman role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON, so every dollar figure on a work order (line Rate/Total, the Financial Info card, and the Finance/Stats money) must be visible and not hidden or masked. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Foreman row #28]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Foreman, every price and dollar amount on a work order should be visible.
actual_result_plain: Opened invoiced work order S9-24661 as Tech-with-Foreman-role. All money was visible. The Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $929.72, Shop Supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71 and Balance $1,078.71. The Lines grid showed the line Rate $232.43 and Total $929.72. Nothing was hidden or masked. fe-permissions confirm cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true and view_mode=full for the Foreman role.
notes: fe-permissions: seeFinancialData=true, view_mode=full, woFullViewMode present. Money confirmed on the Financial Info card and Lines grid.

where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
what_to_do: Try to delete the work order.
expected_result: BLOCKED. Foreman has Work Orders = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Foreman role has Work Orders = View + Create and Edit but NOT Delete, so a Foreman must not be able to delete a work order; the 'Delete Work Order' control should not be offered. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Foreman row #29]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Foreman, there should be no way to delete a work order.
actual_result_plain: Opened uncomplete work order S9-24075 (status 'In Progress') as Tech-with-Foreman-role and opened the work-order nav-bar menu (three-dot menu). The menu showed only 'Audit Log' and 'Timesheets (4)' with NO 'Delete Work Order' option. For comparison, the same menu on the same work order as Admin shows 'Audit Log | Timesheets (4) | Delete Work Order'. So the delete control is absent for the Foreman. fe-permissions confirm workOrdersDelete=false for the Foreman role.
notes: Real denial by control absence. Foreman fe-permissions has workOrdersDelete=false. Admin's nav menu on the same WO includes 'Delete Work Order' (though disabled here because the WO has labor clocked in); the Foreman menu omits the option entirely.

expected_result: Allowed. Foreman has Work Order Lines Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Foreman role has Work Order Lines = Delete, so a Foreman is allowed to delete a (non-completed) work-order line. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Foreman row #30]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Foreman, deleting a work-order line should work.
actual_result_plain: Opened work order S9-24181 (Approved) as Tech-with-Foreman-role. It had 4 lines. Selected the deletable line 'Replace - Brake pot' (status Authorized, no labor), opened the line bulk-action menu ('Set line status | Delete lines | Split work order') and clicked 'Delete lines'. The line was removed: the Lines header count went from Lines (4) to Lines (3) and the line's row disappeared. The UI's own call POST /api/work-orders/lines/delete-lines returned HTTP 200.
notes: fe-permissions has workOrderLinesDelete=true. Deletion driven fully in the UI (hover row -> tick line checkbox -> Line bulk-action -> Delete lines). Confirmed by line-count drop 4->3 and delete-lines endpoint returning 200.
